comic.1: “A real table! Customers can finally sit down.”
comic.8: “The new bar is gorgeous. People are lining up!”
comic.15: “Look at those lights… we did it. Best café on the coast!”
ui.needStars: Need {n} more stars. Fill orders to earn them!
ad.label: Advertisement
ui.chainTip: Merge two of the same item to get the next one.
ui.tasksDone: All tasks done! More coming soon.
ui.bubbleBody: Grab this {item} before the bubble pops in {t}.
ui.levelBody: {xp} / {need} XP to level {next}. Every order earns XP.
ui.stuck: No matches left. Sell an item to make room!
line.mia.1: Hi! I'm Mia from the bookshop next door. Your latte smells like a good first chapter.
line.mia.3: I keep telling customers about your café. Half of them come here before they buy a book now.
line.mia.5: I wrote the shop newsletter about this place. It's officially my favorite chapter.
line.kai.1: Kai. I teach surfing down the beach. Feed me and I'll tell you where the waves are.
line.kai.3: My students think your toast is part of the training plan. I'm not correcting them.
line.kai.5: Caught the best wave of the season today. Powered by your coffee, of course.
line.rose.1: I'm Rose. I've watched this stall for forty summers. It hasn't looked this good in years.
line.rose.3: I had my first date on this beach. Your sandwiches taste like those summers.
line.rose.5: You've given this old corner its heart back, dear. I'm proud of you.
line.leo.1: Leo. I write novels, or I try to. Your cold brew is the only thing finishing my chapters.
line.leo.3: I put a little seaside café in my book. Guess who runs it?
line.leo.5: The book is done! You're in the acknowledgements. Twice.
line.marcus.1: Marcus, from the sailing club. My crew voted your fruit tart the official snack.
line.marcus.3: We named the new dinghy after your fruit tart. Don't ask whose idea that was.
line.marcus.5: Regatta's on Sunday. The whole club wants your café to cater it.
line.chloe.1: Chloe, wedding planner. Always running, never without cake.
line.chloe.3: A bride asked where I found that cream cake. I said it's a secret. It's you.
line.chloe.5: I'm booking your café for my own wedding. Yes, really. Save me a cake!
ui.wildGot: Wild Star! Drop it on any item to level it up.
ui.digHint: Drop a {item} here to dig it out!
ui.unlockHidden: Open this tile for {n} coins? You'll get the {item} inside.

ui.loginBody: Come back every day. Missed days never reset your progress.

ui.potHint: When energy is full, extra brews into your coffee pot (up to {n}) and pours in when you run out.
ui.bigOrder: Big order: no time limit, and +{n} energy back when served.
ui.pantryTip: Drag items here to keep them off the board.
ui.pantryTap: Tap the coin slot to add pantry space.
ui.pantryBuyBody: Add pantry slot {n} of {max}? Stored items stay off the board — drag them back to merge or serve.
